arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal: settle after the hard start to about critical power (boat ~122 W, shaft ~189 W, to be checked by heart rate: HR should level off at CP), spend reserve evenly, keep ~30-40 % reserve for the last 1000-1500 m, then finish sprint around 600-800 m to go. Watch for incidents (weed on rudder = speed drop at same pod power; pod drift = pod power vs boat power/HR disagree; radio course change). Use pieces/measure only if they pay.
Good start. Settle now into your race rhythm.
